# Test fixtures

Sample input files for manual and automated testing.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `sample.dcm` | Minimal synthetic DICOM instance. Regenerate with `python -m scripts.make_sample_dcm`. |
| `actual_test.pdf` | Real-world-style radiology report PDF for exercising the upload/parse path. |
| `smoke_test.pdf` | Small PDF used for quick upload smoke checks. |
